Existing/custom buses retain index/name/send/gain/mute/solo/effects because only missing named buses are appended. Final native setup matches the original intent; temporary newly created default send is Master earlier than add_bus, and future insertion/move APIs are outside this workaround.

Engine get_stream_paused returnsfalse with no active playback and does not remember a pause set before play. This existing engine behavior is unchanged; inactive voices can still receive redundanttrue calls that have no playback to forward. Mute0 pauses active voices immediately through session_volume setter; unmute resumes on next GameAmbience processing tick only if tree is unpaused. Tree-paused/unmuted remains paused. While muted but tree-running, original fade/cooldown clocks continue, matching previous scheduling policy.

Starting/stopping/changing streams and real node tree pause/unpause notifications still use the engine lifecycle. Original _transition pre-play pause behavior is unchanged. Actual native/Web mute/resume/owner exit/reentry should be covered in root current-source checks.
